messages:
maria: Planning note — need signoff on proposed PRD for audit log retention + KMS/HSM handling. Draft at https://docs.google.com/... please review acceptance criteria and scope tradeoffs. TL;DR: support 7/30/365 day retention tiers, per-customer opt-in for longer retention, HSM for key wrapping, and redaction policy for PII.
anya: quick q — is 30d default for all hosted customers? that has cost implications.
sam: yes default = 30d for hosted API. Dedicated/private customers can request different retention via contract. we should call out cost estimate in PRD.
maria: adding cost table in doc. @ravi can you add storage/egress estimate per 1M requests/day assuming avg 1.2KB/log? also include S3 vs on-prem storage options.
ravi: will do. also flag: audit logs include request prompts — need clear redaction policy. if customer opts into full prompt retention they must enable data residency and additional legal review.
julie: security note — SOC2 wants tamper-evident logs and HSM-backed key lifecycle. we need HSM integration doc and key rotation plan in PRD. @security-bot any checklist items?
security-bot: Required: immutable append-only audit store, key rotation policy (90 days rotate), KMS/HSM attestation, access control for key ops, retention proof for e-discovery. See high-level checklist: https://confluence.redwood/internal/sec/audit-checklist
anya: edge-case: what if a customer wants 10y retention? legal/archops will need export + long-term cold storage; that's out of scope for initial launch but we should include migration runbook.
maria: agreed — scope out long-term archival as follow-up. initial beta supports up to 365d only.
sam: acceptance criteria proposal:
- audit logs stored encrypted at rest with customer-segregated keys
- retention policy configurable per-customer with pre-defined tiers (7/30/365)
- key material stored in HSM for Dedicated/Private; hosted uses KMS with envelope keys
- deletion is irreversible and auditable; deletion events are recorded
- search by customer-id and time-range; metadata-only queries for deleted payloads
ravi: edge cases: partial deletes (delete only prompt but keep metadata), legal holds should override retention, cross-region replication must respect retention in destination.
julie: SOC2 evidence we need for launch: proof of key rotations, access logs for key operations, audit log integrity verification (hash chain), and control owner assigned.
maria: question on API design — should we expose retention setting via account API or via Console only?
anya: prefer API for infra customers; console for self-serve. both ok.
sam: rough API sketch:
```
POST /v1/accounts/{id}/retention
{
  "tier": "30d",
  "archival": "none",
  "retain_prompts": false
}
```
ravi: need to validate invalid combos (e.g., retain_prompts=true requires archival=on and signed contract). add in PRD.
ops-bot: Deploy note: PRD doc updated by maria at 1998765440
maria: thanks — I've added the API sketch, cost table, and a short HSM integration appendix. please review diff and leave :eyes: or :thumbsup: by EOD Fri.
julie: I'll take security sign-off checklist and populate control owners.
anya: can product do a quick run of acceptance test-cases? i can simulate retention/deletion flows with a dev tenant.
sam: assign to eng-runtime for implementation: @ravi for design, @sam for rollouts plan.
maria: created JIRA epic INF-7237 and linked PRD. reviewers: anya, julie, ravi, sam. ping me with blocking issues.
security-bot: Reminder: update threat model if prompt retention enabled. add privacy impact assessment.
ravi: added PIA template link in doc.
maria: ok locking scope for initial launch: hosted defaults 30d, tiers 7/30/365, HSM for Dedicated/Private, API+Console config, redact-by-default for prompts. long-term archival and 10y requests out of scope. any objections?
anya: none from me.
sam: no objections.
julie: no objection; will follow up on SOC2 evidence tasks.
maria: great — closing thread. final PRD link: https://docs.google.com/... (version 2).
